title: skills(objectstack-ui): pages.md "Inline metadata views" should say an embed may name an item of a declared dependency (after #27090)
body:
Filing gate: ① a Skills-docs follow-up a landed contract change owes. PR #27204 (#27090) declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`; the source is os-dev-report `6466645930` on #27090, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage and the skills lane.

## What is stale

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`, section "Inline metadata views", says a referenced item "must exist in this package — a dead same-package reference fails the build".

Once PR #27204 lands, `docs/metadata-embed-ref` judges a package's doc against two scopes: that package's own body, plus the packages it declares in `manifest.dependencies` (triage ruling `6461907878` on #27090). So an embed of a declared dependency's item builds, and an embed of an undeclared sibling's item is refused.

## Expected

The section names both scopes in one sentence: "this package or a package it declares in `manifest.dependencies`". The refusal for anything else stays as written. Since `skills/**` is read by agents writing metadata apps, the sentence should state the closed rule, not a tolerance.

- Depends on PR #27204 landing first.
- Dedupe words: pages.md inline metadata views embed scope, metadata-embed-ref declared dependency skills.
